run_greeter_client: run the gRPC Greeter client to get a greeting from a server address
create_insecure_channel: create an insecure gRPC channel to connect to a server address
call_sayhello: call the SayHello RPC method on the Greeter stub with a name
create_greeter_stub: create a GreeterStub from a gRPC channel to invoke RPC methods
parse_server_arg: parse the server address argument from the command line using argparse
